rationale: A CORRECTION TO A CLAIM WE MADE OURSELVES. We wrote that a receipt copied onto another pull request fails the subject check. It does not: derived and claimed both come from the same signed subjectContext, so they always agree unless someone hand-builds the statement. Without an expectation supplied from outside, this is a CONSISTENCY check, not a binding to the object the reader is looking at. The absence is now reported instead of passing silently.
